verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official MCP server that lets users ask questions, explore experiments, and access Statsig data in natural language through AI clients like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. The evidence describes read and explore use, not natural-language operation of the product such as creating or changing gates and experiments, and it depends on external AI clients rather than a native natural-language interface. Missing for 10: documented natural-language write/control actions through the MCP server, a native in-product natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
